lines.en: Omar starts a new job today.
He meets Khalid at the office door.
"Good morning. Nice to meet you," Omar says.
"I am a new engineer here. I work in the design team."
lines.ar: «أنا مهندس جديد هنا. أعمل في فريق التصميم.»

questions.explanationAr: عمر هو الذي يبدأ عملًا جديدًا.

questions.prompt: Which team does Omar work in?

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as Khalid. Start with: "Today I met ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان خالد. ابدأ بـ: «Today I met ...»
retell.sample: Today I met a new engineer at the office door. His name is Omar. He said good morning. He works in the design team.

lines.en: Huda reads a report at her desk.
She sees a new word: "backfill".
She asks her colleague Mona, "What does this word mean?"
lines.ar: تسأل زميلتها منى: «ماذا تعني هذه الكلمة؟»

lines.en: Mona explains it to her, and Huda writes it in her notebook.
lines.ar: تشرحها منى لها، فتكتبها هدى في دفترها.

questions.prompt: Where does Huda write the word?

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as Mona. Start with: "Huda asked me ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان منى. ابدأ بـ: «Huda asked me ...»
retell.sample: Huda asked me about a new word in a report. The word was "backfill". I explained it to her. She wrote it in her notebook.

lines.en: Sami cannot print the drawings.
Ali shows him the right printer.
"Thank you for your help," says Sami.
"You're welcome. No problem," Ali answers.
lines.ar: يجيب علي: «على الرحب والسعة. لا مشكلة.»

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as Ali. Start with: "Sami needed ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان علي. ابدأ بـ: «Sami needed ...»
retell.sample: Sami needed help with the printer. I showed him the right printer. He said thank you. I said, "You're welcome."

lines.en: Yousef has a meeting today.
He asks his manager, "What time is the meeting?"
"The meeting starts at ten," the manager says.
lines.ar: يقول المدير: «يبدأ الاجتماع في الساعة العاشرة.»

lines.en: "Thank you. I will be there," Yousef answers.

questions.prompt: What does Yousef say at the end?

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as the manager. Start with: "Yousef asked me ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان المدير. ابدأ بـ: «Yousef asked me ...»
retell.sample: Yousef asked me about the meeting time. I said it starts at ten. He thanked me. He will be there.

lines.en: Mr. Fares needs the pump drawings.
He writes to Nabil, "Could you send me the file?"
lines.ar: يكتب إلى نبيل: «هل يمكنك أن ترسل لي الملف؟»

lines.en: Nabil asks, "When do you need it?"
"I need it by Thursday," Mr. Fares answers.
lines.ar: يجيب السيد فارس: «أحتاجه في موعد أقصاه يوم الخميس.»

questions.prompt: When does Mr. Fares need it?

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as Nabil. Start with: "Mr. Fares asked me ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان نبيل. ابدأ بـ: «Mr. Fares asked me ...»
retell.sample: Mr. Fares asked me for the pump drawings. I asked when he needed them. He needs them by Thursday. I will send the file.

lines.en: Sara is writing the weekly report.
Her manager asks, "Is the report ready?"
"I'm working on it. It's almost finished," Sara says.
lines.ar: تقول سارة: «أعمل عليه الآن. أوشك على الانتهاء.»

lines.en: At four o'clock she says, "It's ready. I'll send it today."
lines.ar: في الساعة الرابعة تقول: «إنه جاهز. سأرسله اليوم.»

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as Sara's manager. Start with: "I asked Sara ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان مديرة سارة. ابدأ بـ: «I asked Sara ...»
retell.sample: I asked Sara about the weekly report. She was working on it. At four o'clock it was ready. She will send it today.

lines.en: Tariq hears a strange noise in the pump room.
lines.ar: يسمع طارق صوتًا غريبًا في غرفة المضخات.

lines.en: He calls his supervisor: "There is a problem with the pump."
The supervisor says, "I will check it now."
Then he says, "Let me call the technician."

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as the supervisor. Start with: "Tariq called me ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان المشرف. ابدأ بـ: «Tariq called me ...»
retell.sample: Tariq called me about a problem with the pump. I checked it. Then I called the technician.

lines.en: The steel for the new tank is late.
Hani writes to the client: "Sorry for the delay."
lines.ar: يكتب هاني إلى العميل: «آسف على التأخير.»

lines.en: "The delivery is late. We need one more day."
"The steel will be on site tomorrow."

questions.prompt: How many more days do they need?

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as the client. Start with: "Hani wrote to me ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان العميل. ابدأ بـ: «Hani wrote to me ...»
retell.sample: Hani wrote to me about the steel. The delivery is late. They need one more day. The steel will be on site tomorrow.

lines.en: In the meeting, Mona has an idea for the schedule.
lines.ar: في الاجتماع، لدى منى فكرة للجدول الزمني.

lines.en: Ahmed says, "I agree. That's a good idea."
Sami says, "I'm not sure. It is expensive."
The manager says, "Let's discuss it tomorrow."

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as Ahmed. Start with: "In the meeting, Mona ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان أحمد. ابدأ بـ: «In the meeting, Mona ...»
retell.sample: In the meeting, Mona had an idea for the schedule. I agreed with her. Sami was not sure. We will discuss it tomorrow.

lines.en: A new worker arrives at the site.
The safety officer says, "Please wear your helmet."
lines.ar: يقول مسؤول السلامة: «من فضلك ارتدِ خوذتك.»

lines.en: "Be careful, the floor is wet near the tank."
The worker asks, "Where is the site office?"

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as the safety officer. Start with: "A new worker arrived ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان مسؤول السلامة. ابدأ بـ: «A new worker arrived ...»
retell.sample: A new worker arrived at the site. I told him to wear his helmet. I said the floor near the tank was wet. He asked about the site office.

lines.en: Nabil calls the main office.
"Can I speak to Mr. Hassan, please?"
lines.ar: «هل يمكنني التحدث مع السيد حسن من فضلك؟»

lines.en: The secretary says, "He is in a meeting now."
"Can I leave a message? Please tell him I'll call him back."
lines.ar: «هل يمكنني ترك رسالة؟ أخبره من فضلك أنني سأعاود الاتصال به.»

questions.prompt: Who does Nabil want to speak to?

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as the secretary. Start with: "Nabil called ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان السكرتير. ابدأ بـ: «Nabil called ...»
retell.sample: Nabil called the office. He wanted to speak to Mr. Hassan. Mr. Hassan was in a meeting. Nabil left a message.

lines.en: It is five o'clock, and Omar's work is finished.
lines.ar: الساعة الخامسة، وقد انتهى عمل عمر.

lines.en: He says to Khalid, "I'm leaving now. Thanks for today."
lines.ar: يقول لخالد: «سأغادر الآن. شكرًا على اليوم.»

lines.en: Khalid answers, "See you tomorrow."
"Have a good evening," Omar says at the door.
lines.ar: يقول عمر عند الباب: «أتمنى لك مساءً طيبًا.»

retell.promptEn: Tell the story as Khalid. Start with: "At five o'clock, Omar ..."
retell.promptAr: احكِ القصة على لسان خالد. ابدأ بـ: «At five o'clock, Omar ...»
retell.sample: At five o'clock, Omar finished his work. He thanked me for the day. I said, "See you tomorrow." He wished me a good evening.
